cases.title: Evaluate a dependency
cases.text: Before adopting a new open source library, check its actual size, not just file count. A 50-file repo might be 20k lines of dense C++ or 500 lines of glue code. SLOC gives you the real picture before you commit to a dependency.

cases.title: Estimate project scope
cases.text: Clients and stakeholders ask how big a codebase is. SLOC gives you a solid number before a review or audit: 12k lines across 8 languages, 89% code, 4% comments.

cases.title: Compare forks or alternatives
cases.text: Paste two repos and compare language breakdowns side by side. See how much a fork diverged, or how different two implementations of the same spec really are.

steps.title: Resolve
steps.text: OctoCounts validates the public GitHub URL and resolves the requested branch, tag, or commit SHA to a pinned commit hash via the GitHub API. Pinning to a commit means the analysis is deterministic: the same URL and ref always produce the same count, and the cache key is stable regardless of branch movement.

steps.title: Count
steps.text: The Rust backend downloads a compressed archive, not a full git clone. It skips generated folders like node_modules, vendor, and .git, then tokei counts every source file in a background worker queue.

steps.title: Cache
steps.text: Reports are stored by owner, repo, commit SHA, and tokei version. When you re-analyze the same commit, the cache is hit immediately, with no re-download and no re-count. Re-run forces a fresh analysis and updates the cache. The browser extension also caches results locally for instant offline viewing.

errorHelp.private_repo: OctoCounts analyzes public repositories only. It does not request GitHub account access, does not support private repositories, and does not accept source-code uploads.
errorHelp.ref_not_found: Check the ref field for typos, or leave it empty to use the repository default branch.
errorHelp.empty_repository: The repository has no commits, so there is nothing to count. Retrying will not change that.
errorHelp.rate_limited: Wait a few minutes and retry. Cached reports continue to load instantly when available.
errorHelp.too_large: The analyzer has size and timeout limits. Try a smaller ref or retry later.
errorHelp.not_found: Confirm that the repository exists and is public. Private repositories are intentionally out of scope.
errorHelp.github_request_failed: GitHub did not return a usable archive or repository response. Retry after a short wait.
errorHelp.analysis_failed: The archive downloaded, but the counting step failed. Retry once; if it repeats, the repository may hit an analyzer edge case.
errorHelp.default: Retry the analysis, or check the repository URL and ref.
